page_title: PIS 3-1 CAG | Pisa v Cagliari 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Nicolas Andrade comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris did his best and is replaced by Idrissa Toure (Pisa).
89' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' The free kick is taken by Agustin Albarracin (Cagliari), but ball is cleared.
81' The match has ended for Adam Obert (Cagliari) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Federico La Penna pulls out a red card!
81' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and signals a foul after Adam Obert (Cagliari) brought his opponent down.
79' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is able to continue to play.
79' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
78' The referee is firm and issues Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) a deserved yellow card.
76' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
76' It is time for a substitution. Agustin Albarracin (Cagliari) is on for Jose Pedro.
75' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the right post.
75' The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.

74' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
72' A substitution has been made. Matteo Tramoni goes off and Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) comes on.
70' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.

67' 3 - 1 Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) meets a perfect cross from Alberto Dossena on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the right side of the goal. It's 3:1.
64' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Semih Kilicsoy is replaced by Yael Trepy (Cagliari).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Gianluca Gaetano can be given a rest.
63' The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
61' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Michel Aebischer (Pisa).
60' Adam Obert (Cagliari) went to the ground quite willingly.
59' Adam Obert (Cagliari) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
54' 3 - 0 Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) scores with a header from inside the box after a goalmouth scramble.
54' Samuele Angori (Pisa) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Pisa will take a corner kick.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is gifted a chance inside the box and makes no mistake putting the ball into the net with a fine header. 2:0.
52' Pisa have a corner.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
49' The game is interrupted now, Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Pedro (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Oscar Hiljemark is forced to make a change. Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is unable to continue due to injury, Raul Albiol comes on.
46' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Michel Adopo will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
46' Substitution. Yerry Mina makes way for Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.

45+6' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Elia Caprile makes a great save to stop his effort.
45+5' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+4' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Nicolas Andrade makes a comfortable save.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Cagliari win a corner.

45' That didn't go as planned! Adam Obert (Cagliari) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Nicolas Andrade, who easily kept it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Cagliari quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
43' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Michel Aebischer (Pisa).
37' The game is interrupted as Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) is sent off by the referee.
34' Samuele Angori (Pisa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
30' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
29' It looks like Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) saw red with that tackle. Federico La Penna won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
26' Adam Obert (Cagliari) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
24' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) commits a foul during an attacking move.

20' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Elia Caprile!
19' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Oscar Hiljemark is forced to make a change. Marius Marin is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa).
16' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
9' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Stefano Moreo (Pisa) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Elia Caprile no chance!
8' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Pisa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
8' The referee points directly to the penalty spot and looks confident with his decision!

5' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post.
2' A pass by Michel Aebischer (Pisa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The match has just started.
Cagliari will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Federico La Penna.
